name: Fathers And Children
overview: Scripture reveals a God-ordained relationship between fathers and children marked by honor, care, and instruction. Children are called to obey and honor their parents, which brings blessing and longevity as promised in Exodus 20:12 and Ephesians 6:1. Fathers are to nurture and train their children in the ways of the Lord, recognizing that children are a precious heritage from God (Psalms 127:3; Proverbs 22:6). Ultimately, Malachi 4:6 highlights the need for restored hearts between fathers and children, reflecting God's compassionate care as exemplified in Psalms 103:13.
